plugins.name: Shiver
plugins.description: The server half of the Shiver apps: each member's Shiver settings kept on the server so they follow them to every device (muted channels, custom statuses, push notifications), and usernames in their role colour for everyone.

plugins.name: Shiver Temp Share
plugins.description: Share large files with links that expire after a set time or number of downloads.

plugins.name: Shiver Media Player
plugins.description: Watch videos together in a voice channel with shared play, pause and seek controls.
